summary: Both editions were independently checked against all seven paragraphs of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the household contrast, emphatic negative concerning immediate forgiveness, necessity of affliction, endurance and clean-heart conditions, and conditional closing promises. Bracketed editorial supplements remain distinguished from unbracketed text, and disclosed alternatives do not displace the working readings. Repentance terminology follows the passage’s moral-spiritual context without imposing an additional doctrinal formula. The witness notes are compatible with the supplied bounded project reports and distinguish damage, supplies, and unpreserved passages from omissions. Acceptance is limited to these supplied texts and disclosures; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation or unique interpretation.
